reviews.text:
Pets friendly and correct!
Helpfully!
Rachel was incredibly kind, informative and  caring. Couldn’t recommend more highly - thank you!
The Vet was very plesant and helpful and had a great concern for our dog's Welfare
I have been taking our dogs to Fivelands for years now and familiarity is a good thing. Have been happy with support and treatments when needed. It's also very close and convenient.
Great local vets
I’ve been going to Fivelands for a good few years. Always received the best attention for my dogs needs. I recommend Fivelands practice.
Very friendly and professional service.  Thank you.
Staff are lovely and polite. They go above and beyond to help. Very happy to be bringing my kitten here, i know she is very well looked after.

Great vets!
Thank you to Angharad and the team for looking after our dog Pablo and for his recent vaccinations.
Everyone is so friendly and helpful. Much appreciated.
However I wait  for 30 mins..... the vet was thoroughly .Thank you for taking such good care of my cat. I really appreciate your help and kindness.
Cannot fault Fivelands vet in any way .The service given towards my pet and myself was excellent . Always amazing staff very friendly and caring cannot fault in anyway .
Nice place to get your pet checked. The staff is soo much cooperative and friendly.
Excellent I was explained everything I needed to know with a Smile Thank You

I have been twice now at this vet surgery with my cat and each time had a great service. No waiting times and I am confident about the vets expertise. She was able to calm my cat very quickly and examined her thoroughly. Very friendly staff, good advice and does not feel like a rip off. Got a good course of treatment for my cat and very helpful advice.

I took my very nervous Oriental Havana girl  to see Angharad at Hall Green. She treated my baby with the utmost respect and care. I loved that I was listened to when I was asked questions about what was happening with my cat. Angharad was very helpful in a controlled way and managed a thorough examination by wrapping her in a towel assisted by a nurse (who was also lovely). I was as nervous as my cat - but there was nothing to actually worry about. I have been with the Fivelands Group for many years and would always highly recommend.
Great service
An excellent vets, professional, caring, supportive. We took our 2 kittens just now for vaccinations. Highly recommended for your pet.
Excellent Veterinary, definitely go there again. Vet was very thorough, very caring and professional

Took my two rescue kittens. the  vet was absolutely  brilliant  with lilly and ruby my brother recommended  fivelands  as used with Digby his cat. First  consultation  was really smooth  and made the kittens relaxed  as very nervous .recommended  their pet plan with no obligation  which I took them up on really recommended  fivelands  great service
My GSD treated with care and our visit was pleasant. Spacious reception area.
Professional, efficient, informative, quality and compassionate service provided for my cat, by Anghared Thomas and also Sue, who processed my Petplan claim on the same day. Thank you.

Both the clinician and receptionist were amazing throughout the consultation, and beyond.  Incredibly kind, helpful and professional. I've been using Fivelands for many, many years, and would not consider anywhere else whilst living in Birmingham.

Asked for help with an injured cat, ( leg injury) not our cat, were told they wouldn't look at it unless we gave them £64, consolation fee we explained it wasn't our cat and we found it injured at the back of there premises, wouldnt help, shame vets don't care anymore, just interested in money

Thank you AM for taking the time to leave a rating.
Kind regards,
The Fivelands team.

Good reception and great care. Delicate treatment with a lot of patience and dedication to listening to all the information you want to give about your animal. Get useful advice and necessary treatments without complications or long waiting times.
Angharad is an excellent vet, very kind and caring and she goes above and beyond to put my dogs at ease and make the consultation as stress free as possible.
